edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Company shall pay the Executive an annual base salary of the amount set forth in Schedule 1, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable deductions and withholdings. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, in each case subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies. Any bonus or equity compensation shall be governed by the applicable written plan or award agreement.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive the severance amount and payment terms set forth in Schedule 1, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company and its affiliates. For purposes of this Agreement, “Cause” means the Executive’s willful and continued failure to perform material duties after written notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure, willful misconduct or gross negligence in the performance of duties, conviction of or plea of guilty or no contest to a felony involving fraud or dishonesty, or material breach of this Agreement that remains uncured after written notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETITION. During employment and for twelve months after termination, the Executive shall not, within any jurisdiction in which the Executive had material responsibility on the Company’s behalf during the twelve months preceding termination, perform services substantially similar to those performed for the Company for a business that directly competes with a material business of the Company with which the Executive was materially involved. This restriction does not prohibit passive ownership of up to two percent of a publicly traded company, or employment with a business unit that does not compete with the Company, provided the Executive does not provide services to a competing business. This Section applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law.
edits.name: Non-Competition

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive severance equal to 18 months of the Executive’s then-current base salary, payable in a lump sum within 10 business days after the Executive executes the required release and the release becomes effective and non-revocable, subject to applicable deductions and withholdings. The Executive’s right to severance is conditioned on execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company and its affiliates. For purposes of this Agreement, “Cause” means the Executive’s willful and continued failure to perform material duties after written notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure, willful misconduct or gross negligence in the performance of duties, conviction of or plea of guilty or no contest to a felony involving fraud or dishonesty, or material breach of this Agreement that remains uncured after written notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
edits.name: Severance amount and payment terms

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETITION. During employment and for twelve months after termination, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, provide services in a competing capacity to a business that competes with a business conducted by the Company in any market in which the Company conducts business, where the services to be provided could reasonably be expected to use or benefit from the Executive’s knowledge of the Company’s confidential information or strategic plans, or where the Executive’s role would otherwise create a material risk of use or disclosure of such information. This restriction applies only to services relating to the competing business and does not prohibit passive ownership of up to two percent of a publicly traded company, or employment with a business unit that does not compete with the Company, provided the Executive does not provide services to a competing business. This Section applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law.
edits.name: Revised non-competition provision
